BiblicalUsage: Evil-Merodak is a Babylonian king. The name appears in 2 Kings and Jeremiah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Evil-Merodak matters because God knows His people by name — even the ones Scripture mentions only once.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
